statement: Let X, V, Y be smooth connected projective varieties with dim Y > 0, let π : V → X be birational, and let f : V → Y be surjective. Suppose an algebraic torus T acts equivariantly on these maps and trivially on Y . Give L = −KX its natural linearization and a smooth semipositive metric invariant under the maximal compact torus. Put L′ = π∗L, J = KV/X, and let t be its natural invariant Jacobian section. Assume that B = (f∗OV (J))T has rank one. Via division by t, view B as a sheaf of rational functions on Y , and write B∨∨ = OY (B0) and R = B0 − KY . Then the invariant adjoint L2 metric extends to a singular semipositive metric ψR on R, and (33) OY (B0) ⊗ I(ψR) = B. If, on a nonempty patch in the smooth base-change locus where t is nonzero, the curvature of L′ dominates the pullback of a positive base form, then ψR is smooth and strictly positive on a base coordinate ball.
